calls.summary: James Shannon (GrowthBook) discussed deployment architecture options (managed warehouse vs. warehouse native and self-hosting) and AI capabilities (MCP server for feature flag creation and analytics) with Lan Ha (automotive) and Thao Nguyen (real estate), who highlighted pain points around per-seat pricing and limited accessibility. Lan and Thao explained their current managed warehouse setup across up to three verticals and an openness to warehouse native or self-hosted models. Next steps: James will incorporate these insights into the RFP proposal, follow up with procurement manager Monica to identify their current vendor for migration support, and plan for potential proof-of-concept testing.
